tony: ack. link?

deploybot: Usage: `/deploy pin <target> --scope=<scope> --ttl=<minutes> --note="<reason>"`
maya: /deploy pin engine:v3.2.1-q --scope=staging-canary --ttl=90 --note="pack+oom-staging-hold"
deploybot: engine:v3.2.1-q pinned (scope=staging-canary, ttl=90m, note=pack+oom-staging-hold).
sre-bot: Alert rule suggestion: prod/OOMs >=1 in 5m -> rollback + page oncall; staging OOMs >=3 in 30m -> rollback.
maya: running `./ci/release.sh --artifact v3.2.1-q --rebuild --verify` now. hotfix branch hotfix/quant-pad-revert opened.
tony: update release notes: Hold v3.2.1-q due to packaging verification failure and canary OOMs.
maya: timeline: rebuild 10m, mem/regress 20m, hotfix PR 45m. will report updates here.
